Hi Sam — glad you signed up and thanks for the payload. We can absolutely cover streaming and log retention during the call.

Confirmed: Thu 07/29 10:00–10:30 PT (I've held the slot). You should receive a Google Calendar invite from Marissa (cc'd) in a minute — please accept to lock it.

What we'll cover in 30 minutes (attached agenda):
- 5 min: Quick intro & goals
- 10 min: Live sandbox smoke test (streaming + sample payload)
- 10 min: Observability & retention options (how to export logs, retention windows for sandboxes vs. dedicated)
- 5 min: Next steps and recommended config for your POC

Notes on retention: sandboxes are short-lived by default (7 days). For POCs we recommend exporting responses to an S3 bucket or streaming to your ingestion endpoint — we'll demo a tiny Node example that captures chunks as they arrive.

Marissa will run the demo; I'll be on the call for product questions. HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/9999999/contact/SHOPLIFT-12345.
